label: Earth
depicts: Globe outline with vertical longitude lines and horizontal latitude lines
use_when: Use when the interface wants the most complete globe grid with both meridians and latitude bands.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simpler globe variants when the fuller grid pattern should stay visible.

label: Earth
depicts: Globe outline with two curved side lines and one horizontal equator line
use_when: Use when the interface needs a simpler globe with one equator and two side meridians.
avoid_when: Do not use for the fuller globe grid when the cleaner three band structure matters.

label: Earth
depicts: Globe outline with a top cap panel side lines and one equator line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a globe whose top arc is split into a visible cap section.
avoid_when: Do not use for the standard globe when the top cap cut should remain visible.

label: Earth
depicts: Globe outline with two tall inner lobes and one horizontal equator line
use_when: Use when the interface needs the most minimal globe made from two tall inner lobes and an equator.
avoid_when: Do not use for the fuller grid globes when only two inner vertical lobes are shown.

label: Book
depicts: Open book outline with softly curved bottom edges and two facing page panels
use_when: Use when the interface wants an open book whose bottom edges curve downward more softly than the flat book icon.
avoid_when: Do not use for the straighter open book when the wavy lower page edges matter visually.
